evaluation.summary: The request to add rate limiting is underspecified in several consequential dimensions: the rate limit threshold (requests per second/minute), the scope of limiting (per-IP, global, or per-user), and the behavior when the limit is exceeded (429 response, delay, or drop). These choices materially affect the implementation.

gaps.description: Rate limit threshold is not specified (e.g., 10 req/s, 100 req/min).
gaps.consequence: The token bucket or sliding window parameters cannot be set without this; a wrong default could make the service unusable or trivially bypassable.

gaps.description: Scope of rate limiting is unspecified: per-IP, global across all clients, or per some other identity.
gaps.consequence: Per-IP limiting requires IP extraction and a map of limiters; global limiting uses a single counter — these are structurally different implementations.

gaps.description: Behavior on limit breach is not defined (immediate 429, retry-after header, silent drop, queuing).
gaps.consequence: Affects the HTTP response contract and client-side retry logic.

package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"io"
	"log"
	"net/http"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"
)

type note struct {
	ID   int    `json:"id"`
	Text string `json:"text"`
}

func newHandler(now func() time.Time) http.Handler {
	var mu sync.Mutex
	var next time.Time
	notes := []note{}
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	mux.HandleFunc("/notes", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		mu.Lock()
		t := now()
		if t.Before(next) {
			mu.Unlock()
			w.Header().Set("Retry-After", "1")
			http.Error(w, "rate limit exceeded", http.StatusTooManyRequests)
			return
		}
		next = t.Add(100 * time.Millisecond)
		mu.Unlock()
		switch r.Method {
		case http.MethodGet:
			mu.Lock()
			defer mu.Unlock()
			w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
			json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(notes)
		case http.MethodPost:
			var n note
			body, err := io.ReadAll(http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, 65536))
			if err != nil || json.Unmarshal(body, &n) != nil || strings.TrimSpace(n.Text) == "" {
				http.Error(w, "expected JSON with nonempty text (max 64 KiB)", http.StatusBadRequest)
				return
			}
			mu.Lock()
			n.ID = len(notes) + 1
			notes = append(notes, n)
			mu.Unlock()
			w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
			w.WriteHeader(http.StatusCreated)
			json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(n)
		default:
			w.Header().Set("Allow", "GET, POST")
			http.Error(w, "method not allowed", http.StatusMethodNotAllowed)
		}
	})
	return mux
}

func main() {
	s := &http.Server{Addr: ":8080", Handler: newHandler(time.Now), ReadTimeout: 5 * time.Second, WriteTimeout: 10 * time.Second}
	log.Fatal(s.ListenAndServe())
}
